description.value: The Marmalade Cat Café is a community-oriented café on Pandosy Street in Kelowna serving specialty coffees, handmade baked goods, brunch, and sandwiches with homemade soups. The café supports local culture by displaying and selling work by local artists, giving it a distinctly neighbourhood feel. Dietary accommodations include gluten-free baked goods, vegan sandwiches on request, and milk alternatives such as almond, oat, and soy.
